ios.//: ascAppId is the numeric Apple ID from App Store Connect > App Information. appleTeamId is on developer.apple.com > Membership. Neither is a secret; the App Store Connect API key is, and belongs in EAS credentials, not here.

android.//: Upload to the closed-testing track first and promote from the Play Console once the release has been reviewed. Point serviceAccountKeyPath at a local JSON key that is NOT committed, or omit it and let `eas credentials` hold the key.
